Kenji Watanabe: Heads-up: Arcwave Systems invoice ARC-2025-12 (USD 14,620) is 52 days overdue. They9re disputing the tax line (VAT) and asked us to hold collection while they sort with their tax advisor. CS says they want service kept online if we accept a partial payment. Thoughts?

Priya Rao: Share the invoice lines and contract tax clause, will check legal exposure.

Kenji Watanabe: Quick snapshot:
```
Invoice: ARC-2025-12
Issued: 2025-09-10
Due: 2025-10-13
Amount: $14,620.00 (includes $1,120 VAT)
Status: Past due 52 days
Auto-collect: failed (card expired)
```

Zara Khan: Customer emailed claiming VAT double-charged due to EU intermediary. Wants our finance team to refund VAT and hold collection for net amount. They9re asking to keep service on.

Owen Miller: Sales feedback: account is strategic small ARR, risk of churn if service cut. They9d accept a 60% immediate payment (net of disputed VAT) and the balance after audit. We need guardrails.

Priya Rao: Contract says taxes are the customer9s responsibility and we invoice gross. We can agree to escrow the disputed VAT amount while they provide evidence, but we should require at least 50% of the undisputed amount now. No service restore until initial payment clears.

invoices-bot: Notice: autopay failed for ARC-2025-12 on 2025-11-08. Retry scheduled 2025-11-25.

Kenji Watanabe: Proposed approach: ask for 60% immediate payment of the invoice net of the $1,120 VAT (so pay $8,692 now), place $1,120 in escrow pending tax docs, and pay remaining balance in 30 days once dispute resolved. Waive late fee if they sign the agreement within 48h.

Zara Khan: Fine, but require a signed amendment and a clear deadline (30 days) for their tax docs. If they don9t produce evidence, we invoice full amount and pursue collections.

Owen Miller: Sales agrees. Also recommend offering a single 15-min call to speed up documentation.

Priya Rao: Legal: OK to escrow disputed tax if customer provides qualified tax opinion within 30 days. Add clause that if they fail to provide, escrow releases to Redwood and account goes to collections. I9ll prepare a short amendment template.

Kenji Watanabe: Draft outreach below 5:30 PT, keeping it tight.

Kenji Watanabe:
``` 
Subject: Follow-up on invoice ARC-2025-12 and VAT dispute

Hi Team,

We can proceed with a temporary arrangement to avoid disruption. Proposed terms:
- 60% of the invoice net of disputed VAT due immediately via payment link
- $1,120 (VAT amount) placed in escrow pending your tax documentation
- Remaining balance due in 30 days after receipt of tax docs
- Waive late fees if amendment is signed within 48 hours
- Service will resume once initial payment clears

Please confirm if you accept and we9ll send the amendment and payment link. Happy to do a 15-min call to finalize.

Thanks,
Kenji
Finance Ops
```

Priya Rao: Add a line asking them to confirm preferred payment method and PO if any.

Kenji Watanabe: Good call, will add. Sending at 15:32 PT. If no signed amendment in 48h, we proceed with standard dunning and Sales will pause renewals.

invoices-bot: Reminder: retry attempt scheduled for 2025-11-25 for ARC-2025-12.

Zara Khan: Thanks team 5. Tracking here.

Owen Miller: I'll standby to join the call. If they accept and then miss payment #2, escalate to Collections.
